name: Content Moderation Info Block
description: A block, derived per moderated entity type, that displays moderation info (changed date, author, latest-revision indicator, current state) for the entity in context and can embed an inline form to change its moderation or publish state.
project_description:
This module provides a block containing content moderation related information of the entity being viewed. It also allows the moderation state to be changed outside of the entity's edit form.

 This block offers similar moderation information provided by the Workbench Moderation module in Drupal 7.

 The block displays the following information related to the entity:

 
 The changed date 
 The author 
 If your are viewing the latest revision (Yes/No) 
 The current moderation status 
 A form to change the moderation status (with a revision log message field) 
 
 Any of the options above can be turned on and off on the blocks configuration form.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Enable the module 
 Go to the block layout admin page (admin/structure/block) 
 Add a Content Moderation Info block 
 Select the options you want to display 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 The only dependency is the Content Moderation module which became stable in Drupal 8.5 .
